CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future.

We’re building a modern enterprise data warehouse on Snowflake and need a BI Analyst who works directly with the business to turn data into decisions. You’ll partner with stakeholders to scope their reporting needs, build dashboards, and teach teams how to use them. This role is as much about relationships and enablement as it is about building.

What You'll Do:
Partner with stakeholders across finance, sales, and operations to understand their goals and translate them into clear requirements and KPIs

Scope dashboard projects: define success criteria, prioritize requests, set timelines, and manage expectations

Build, publish, and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI (or Tableau) that are accurate , intuitive, and actionable

Write SQL against Snowflake to explore data, validate results, and support ad hoc analysis

Work with Data Engineering to shape the semantic layer and data models, define KPI and calculation logic, flag data quality issues, and improve report performance and Snowflake costs

Build the business definitions and synonyms that help AI tools (like Snowflake Cortex Analyst or Power BI Copilot) answer questions correctly

Test AI-generated reports and text-to-SQL results against known-correct answers before they go live

Run training sessions, workshops, and office hours that build self-service skills across the business

Create user guides, metric definitions, and walkthroughs so business users can trust and navigate the data

Gather feedback after launch, track adoption, and iterate on dashboards

What You'll Bring:
5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, FP&A, or a similar role

Strong dashboarding skills in Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable BI tool

Working SQL proficiency (joins, aggregations, CTEs, basic window functions)

Demonstrated ability to run requirements-gathering conversations and turn vague asks into scoped deliverables

Hands-on use of AI tools in analytical work, with the judgment to evaluate output quality and spot unsupported answers.

Experience facilitating trainings , workshops, or demos for non-technical audiences

Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain data clearly

Strong attention to detail and a habit of validating numbers before sharing them

Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Snowflake or another cloud data warehouse

Familiarity with DAX and dimensional modeling concepts

Experience writing business definitions, synonyms, or test cases for AI-driven or natural-language analytics tools.

Background in finance, FP&A, or sales operations

Exposure to dbt , Fivetran , or modern data stack tools

Experience building a data community or champions program

Bachelor’s degree in Finance , Business, IT, Analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience)

CrossCountry Consulting is required to include an estimate of the compensation range for this role. The following range takes into account a wide range of factors including but not limited to, skills, experience, education, licenses, certifications, business needs, and internal equity. An estimate of the current range is $120,000 - $175,000 per year + annual bonus + additional benefits.

#LI-AJ1

Benefits Summary

The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; and a 401(k) with company matching. Additionally, employees can take advantage of generous parental and maternity leave policies, technology stipends, and wellness reimbursement programs, all designed to support both professional growth and personal well-being. For detailed information about benefits at CrossCountry, please visit our dedicated benefits site: https://www.crosscountry-consulting.com/careers/benefits/ .

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)

CrossCountry provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment and believes that respect and fair treatment are critical to creating a productive and inclusive workplace.

As an equal opportunity employer, CrossCountry is fully committed to comply with all federal, state, and local laws and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, pregnancy, genetics, sexual orientation, veteran status, gender identity or expression or any other protected characteristic. The company also complies with pay transparency and labor laws applicable to all terms and conditions of employment.

title.value: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst - Mobile Growth

description.value:
At Appex, we fuel mobile growth. We specialize in propelling great apps forward, leveraging data and a user-centric approach to unlock each app’s full potential. From Health & Fitness to Travel, Utilities, and Productivity, we supercharge apps like FitnessAI, achieving remarkable user base growth. Join us as we pioneer the future of mobile technology.

What You’ll Do:

As a Business Intelligence Analyst at Appex, you'll play a pivotal role in driving our portfolio of mobile apps to new heights. You'll harness your strong SQL skills and expertise in ad-hoc data digging (using SQL, R, Python, Tableau, PowerBI, Excel, etc.) to unearth actionable insights. Proficiency in at least one popular BI tool (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, Redash) is essential. You'll understand what data is crucial for strategic decision-making versus day-to-day operations, ensuring data accuracy and relevance.

What You’ll be Working On:

Utilize robust SQL skills and proficiency in data tools to conduct ad-hoc analysis and reporting.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define key metrics and deliver actionable insights.

Serve as a critical partner to the CEO and CFO by supporting their daily data needs and requests, providing thorough analysis for our portfolio of mobile apps.

Deliver clean, well-presented data and strategic insights to drive revenue growth across all apps.

Identify and communicate trends in app performance and user engagement, translating findings into actionable strategies.

Develop and maintain compelling dashboards and visualizations to track KPIs, monitor app health and ensure data accuracy.

Apply knowledge of Data Engineering (DBT, Fivetran, ELT) to streamline data pipelines and ensure data integrity.

Contribute to data-driven strategies to optimize user acquisition, retention, and monetization.

What You’ll Bring to the Table:

Strong proficiency in SQL for querying and manipulating large datasets.

Experience in ad-hoc data analysis using tools like R, Python, Tableau, PowerBI, and Excel.

Proficiency in at least one popular BI tool (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker, Redash, etc.).

Ability to differentiate between strategic data insights and operational data needs.

Familiarity with Data Engineering concepts (DBT, Fivetran, ELT) is a plus.

Excellent communication skills with a knack for translating data into actionable insights.

Join Us: If you're passionate about leveraging data to drive mobile growth and thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you. Take the next step in your career with Appex and help shape the future of mobile technology. Apply today and let's build something incredible together.

Introduction Werfen Werfen is a growing, family-owned, innovative company founded in 1966 in Barcelona, Spain. We are a worldwide leader in specialized diagnostics in the areas of Hemostasis, Acute Care Diagnostics, Transfusion, Autoimmunity, and Transplant. Through our Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) business line, we research, develop, and manufacture customized assays and biomaterials. We operate directly in 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Our Headquarters and Technology Centers are located in the US and Europe, and our workforce is more than 7,000 strong. Our success comes from a specific focus in these rapidly evolving diagnostic areas, our commitment to customers, and our dedication to innovation and quality. We’re passionate about providing healthcare professionals the most valuable and complete solutions to improve hospital efficiency and enhance patient care. Overview Position Summary: Provides analytics and business intelligence insights to enable the North America Service & Support leadership team to make informed strategic decisions that drive revenue. The role will act as a consultant to Senior Leadership of Service & Support with a focus on reporting, analytics and fostering strong relationships with business partners (eg. Service, Sales, Finance, IT). They will be looked upon to perform ad-hoc analyses for the business, develop insights that drive actions, and to identify new areas for growth or improvement. This person will be a subject matter expert in this field and will help to lead this function. Responsibilities Key Accountabilities Essential Functions: Proactively identifies trends, risks, and opportunities for the business that could impact Service & Support objectives, strategy and tactics. Presents insights to Service & Support leadership. Responsible for continuous improvement related to data reliability and responsiveness to requests from business. Articulates and concisely explains the strategic implications of complex data to key stakeholders using visualization tools such as MS Power BI to curate and display data from multiple sources. Develops reporting, dashboards and analysis that enable business decisions to drive revenue and profitability. Performs other duties as assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions. Internal Networking/Key Relationships: North America Commercial Operations Client Services Finance IT Qualifications Minimum Knowledge & Experience for the position: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business Analytics or related field required. Master’s degree preferred. Experience: Minimum of 5-7 years of work experience in Sales Operations, Service Operations, Finance or Business Analysis function required. Experience in Medical Device/ IVD industry preferred Additional Skills/Knowledge: Expert skills with MS Excel required. Experience with data visualization tools such as MS Power BI or Tableau required. Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office, databases, web-based applications, etc. Experience with CRM and ERP systems required. SAP experience preferred. Knowledge of service logistics, field service operations, and customer support systems preferred. Experience leveraging statistical analysis, business intelligence tools, and operational data to identify meaningful trends, uncover root causes, forecast future performance, and deliver actionable insights that drive strategic and operational decision-making. Management has the discretion of substituting relevant work experience for a degree and/or making exceptions to the years of experience requirement. Skills & Capabilities: Customer-first mindset. Excellent aptitude for working with large amounts of data and an eye for details. Highly focused, accurate and thorough in work. Ability to present data to end users in a digestible manner. Proven experience as a collaborative team player. Critical-thinking and problem-solving skills; ability to deal with ambiguity. Excellent verbal and written communications skills. Ability to work independently to organize and prioritize tasks. Able to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Travel Requirements: Up to 25% of the time. The annual base salary range for this role is currently $130,000 to $160,000 range. Individual employee compensation will ultimately depend on factors including education, relevant experience, skillset, knowledge, and particular business needs. This role is eligible for medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan retirement benefits with an employer match, as well as paid vacation and sick leave. Our sales roles are eligible for participation in a commission plan and our management, and select professional roles, are eligible for a performance-based bonus. Closing If you are interested in constantly learning and being challenged on a daily basis we encourage you to submit your resume or CV. Werfen is an Equal Opportunity employer and is committed to a diverse workplace. Werfen strictly prohibits unlawful discrimination, harassment or retaliation based upon an individual’s race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin/ancestry, age, mental/physical disability, medical condition, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable state or federal law. If you have a disability and need an accommodation in relation to the online application process, please contact NAtalentacquisition@werfen.com for assistance. We operate directly in over 30 countries, and in more than 100 territories through distributors. Annual revenue is approximately $2 billion and more than 7,000 employees around the world comprise our Werfen team. www.werfen.com

We Impact Lives Through Purpose-Driven Work in A People First Culture

Ascend Learning, a leading healthcare and learning technology company, is the connection between a powerful portfolio of brands serving students, educators, and employers with outcomes-based, data-driven solutions across the lifecycle of learning. From testing to certification, Ascend Learning products are used by physicians, emergency medical professionals, nurses, allied health professionals, certified personal trainers, financial advisors, skilled trades professionals and insurance brokers.

Headquartered in Burlington, MA, with additional office locations and hybrid and remote workers in cities across the U.S., Ascend Learning was recognized by Newsweek and Plant-A Insights Group as one of America’s 2025 Greatest Workplaces as well as America’s Best Places to work for Mental Well-Being for 2025.

We're always looking for talented, passionate professionals to join us in our mission to help change lives. If this sounds like an environment where you'd thrive, read on to learn more.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Ascend Learning is hiring for a senior business intelligence analyst within their healthcare operations center of excellence. The Business Intelligence Analyst role assists organizational decision making by providing and explaining data in an easily consumable format and translates internal and external customers’ business requirements into technical requirements and meaningful solutions.

HOW YOU’LL SPEND YOUR TIME

• Develop advanced, modern Tableau dashboards leveraging best‑practice UI/UX design, interactivity, and performance optimization.

• Work directly with business partners to understand analytical needs and translate them into scalable, actionable BI solutions.

• Use Snowflake, EDW structures, and SSMS to prepare, optimize, and validate datasets used in reporting and analytics.

• Provide clear, consumable data insights to stakeholders at all levels, enabling faster and more informed decision‑making.

• Serve as a visualization thought leader, advising on data storytelling, KPI design, and dashboard usability.

• Independently manage multiple high‑complexity projects, ensuring transparency, accuracy, and on‑time delivery.

• Coach and mentor BI team members in Tableau best practices, data modeling, and analytical methodology.

• Oversee and enhance custom reporting capabilities for quality, scalability, and long‑term value.

• Act as a subject‑matter expert in data ingestion, cleansing, modeling, and visualization techniques.

• Leverage deep product and business knowledge to recommend streamlined, efficient analytical approaches.

WHERE YOU’LL WORK

• This position will work a hybrid schedule from our Leawood, KS or Burlington, MA office preferred. Remote candidates will be considered within the United States.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Analytics, or related field preferred (or equivalent experience)

• 5+ years of Expert‑level Tableau experience to create:complex LOD calculations and table calculations, Advanced parameters and dynamic interactions, High‑value, modern user‑focused visual designs and Performance‑optimized dashboards.

• Strong SQL skills and hands‑on experience with SSMS.

• Experience working with Snowflake and enterprise data warehouse (EDW) environments.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze data from diverse internal/external sources and ensure data accuracy.

• Experience working in Agile environments and managing multiple priorities effectively.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts to technical and non‑technical audiences.

• Self‑starter with strong attention to detail, quality, and data visualization aesthetics.

• Experience with enterprise database technologies (SSMS, SQL Server, DB2, Oracle, etc.).

• Experience with BI tools—Tableau strongly preferred, with experience in Qlik, Power BI, Cognos, or similar tools.

• Experience administering Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud preffered.

• Experience in R, Python, or C# is preferred.

HIRING RANGE

The current full-time, annualized base pay hiring range for this role is -. In accordance with applicable state laws, we are providing the expected pay range for this position. Individual compensation will be determined by various factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, current business needs and local market factors. Most regular, full-time employees are eligible to participate in an Ascend incentive bonus or sales plan.

BENEFITS

• Health, dental, and vision insurance

• Company paid life Insurance

• 401(k) with company match

• Paid time off and parental leave

• Employee assistance program

• Other wellness programs such as Headspace and Airvet

• Charitable matching program

Fostering A Sense of Belonging

Our values-driven culture unifies our teams and inspires a mindset of action, innovation, and collaboration, with a relentless focus on customers. We seek out and celebrate all people and perspectives and cultivate an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and be authentic. Our culture is firmly rooted in the belief that by embracing our differences and drawing on diverse perspectives, we are a stronger, more innovative, and more successful organization where employees experience a sense of belonging.

Full-time

Description
Role Analyzes markets for new or existing products or services for one or more divisions, product lines, or market segments. Generally, uses in-house information systems or external metrics to collect, evaluate, and analyze data on customers, prospective customers, and competitors to determine market penetration. Prepares reports and evaluates potential markets, market conditions and advertising campaigns. Supports roadmap initiatives, existing platform feature enhancement projects, and technical changes to online and mobile banking platforms. Major Duties and Responsibilities 25% POWER BI REPORTING: Meet with keystakeholders about current reports and desired functionality Develop user friendly dashboards leveraging COCCs Datamart and other data inputs Provide knowledge transfer of Microsoft Power BI to TotalVision power users as-needed Document dataflow diagrams and conversion methodology Create a report library of new and converted reports and dashboards 25% TOTAL VISION CONVERSION: Reach out to key stakeholders across departments Catalog existing Total Vision (Crystal) Reports for conversion to PowerBI Create a document library of all converted reports across departments Provide end-user training in COCC Datamart elements and difference between platforms 15% COMMERCIAL/CONSUMER LENDING: Reach out to key stakeholders in loan origination, loan servicing and credit Inquire on non-COCC Insight Applications and reporting requirements Loanwriter, Encompass, LoanVantage Develop knowledge in these applications and reporting / dashboarding options Work with key stakeholders to develop new centralized and user friendly reports and dashboards 15% MARKETING: Assist Director of Marketing with scheduled and ad-hoc reporting across platforms Develop automation of data-feeds and dashboarding for routine and board level reporting Assist with third party datamining and analytics such as Google Analytics, Segmint and MXMoney Include performance metrics from the Haberfeld program and the above to help gauge campaign performance Student survey at Massasoit Community College Collaboration w/ Data Science Department (Professor Brown-Sederberg) Support with identifying cross-sales leads for Cash Management & NII opportunities 15% ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE: Microsoft Co-Pilot 5% Any other duties/projects as assigned.

Requirements
Knowledge and Skills Experience A minimum of one year up to three years of similar or related experience, including preparatory experience. Education/Certifications/Licenses A high school degree or equivalent. Associate’s degree in Business Intelligence (BI), Data Analytics or industry certification in Business Intelligence or Power BI preferred. Interpersonal Skills A significant level of trust, credibility and diplomacy is required. In-depth dialogue, conversations and explanations with customers, direct and indirect reports and outside vendors can be of a sensitive and/or highly confidential nature. Communications may involve motivating, influencing, educating and/or advising others on matters of significance. ADA Requirements Physical Requirements Is able to bend, sit, and stand in order to perform primarily sedentary work with limited physical exertion and occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs. Must be capable of climbing / descending stairs in an emergency situation. Must be able to operate routine o??ce equipment including computer terminals and keyboards, telephones, copiers, facsimiles, and calculators. Must be able to routinely perform work on computer for an average of 6-8 hours per day, when necessary. Working Conditions Must be able to routinely perform work indoors in climate-controlled shared work area with minimal noise. Mental and/or Emotional Requirements Must be able to perform job functions independently or with limited supervision and work effectively either on own or as part of a team. Must be able to read and carry out various written instructions and follow oral instructions. Must be able to complete basic mathematical calculations, spell accurately, and understand computer basics. Must be able to speak clearly and deliver information in a logical and understandable sequence. Must be capable of dealing calmly and professionally with numerous different personalities from diverse cultures at various levels within and outside of the organization and demonstrate highest levels of customer service and discretion when dealing with the public. title.value: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst - Boston, MA

description.value:
$90 - $105
Job Description
A respected organization within the insurance and risk services sector is looking to add a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst to its expanding data and reporting team. This position is an excellent fit for a data-driven professional who thrives on solving business challenges, building impactful reporting solutions, and turning complex information into meaningful insights.
In this role, you will work closely with leaders and stakeholders across multiple departments to deliver analytics that support operational and strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong technical capabilities with the ability to communicate findings clearly, influence decision-making, and drive data adoption throughout the organization.
Location: Boston, MA
Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 3-5 days per week in office
Compensation: Up to $160,000 base salary Required Skills & Experience
+ 3+ years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, reporting, or a related data-focused discipline
+ Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, transforming, and analyzing data
+ Advanced experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Power BI
+ Hands-on experience working with Snowflake environments
+ Solid understanding of relational database concepts and reporting methodologies
+ Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and professional experience
+ Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present technical concepts to business audiences
+ Strong organizational, planning, and project coordination abilities
+ Demonstrated ability to balance independent work with cross-functional collaboration
+ Commitment to data integrity, accuracy, and attention to detail
Desired Skills & Experience
+ Prior experience within the insurance industry
+ Exposure to healthcare insurance, medical malpractice, or related specialty insurance sectors
+ Knowledge of statistical analysis, predictive analytics, or advanced reporting techniques
+ Experience supporting data governance and data quality programs
+ Background working across both business and technology organizations
+ Familiarity with Tableau, Alteryx, SAS, Excel, or similar analytics tools
What You Will Be Doing
Daily Responsibilities
+ Collaborate with business partners to gather requirements and develop data-driven solutions for key business objectives
+ Build, enhance, and support enterprise Power BI dashboards and reporting assets
+ Leverage SQL and Snowflake to access, prepare, and analyze large volumes of data
+ Evaluate datasets to uncover trends, performance drivers, potential risks, and growth opportunities
+ Partner with analytics, technology, and operational teams to establish reporting frameworks and performance metrics
+ Contribute to initiatives focused on improving data governance, consistency, and overall data quality
+ Participate in data modeling and advanced analytics projects
+ Develop compelling visualizations and reporting tools for executive leadership and business users
+ Provide guidance and training on reporting functionality, data usage standards, and self-service analytics best practices
+ Deliver actionable recommendations that support business planning and organizational performance improvements
The Offer
+ Base salary up to $160,000
+ Hybrid work model with approximately 3 days per week in the office
+ Opportunity to contribute to high-impact enterprise analytics and reporting initiatives
+ Collaborative environment with significant visibility across business functions
You will receive the following benefits
+ Medical Insurance
+ Dental Benefits
+ Vision Benefits
+ Paid Time Off (PTO)
+ 401(k)
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the US on a full-time basis now and in the future.
Motion Recruitment Partners (MRP) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants must be currently authorized to work on a full-time basis in the country for which they are applying, and no sponsorship is currently available. Employment is subject to the successful completion of a pre-employment screening. Leader Bank is looking for exceptionally dedicated team members to join one of the region’s fastest growing community banks and mortgage lenders. At the time of its founding in 2002, Leader Bank had one branch office, $6.5 million in assets and 7 team members. Since then, the Bank has become one of the most successful banks in Massachusetts with more than $5 billion in assets, 450+ team members, 7 branch offices, and annual mortgage originations of over $2 billion.

Exemplary products and an innovative spirit have driven Leader Bank’s rapid growth over the years, and our team members embrace these values. Our mission is to obsess over our clients, make them feel valued, and maintain long-term relationships with them by constantly enhancing our products and processes to always improve our client experience. For our team members, Leader Bank prioritizes competitive compensation and benefits, a healthy work-life balance, and an environment that fosters diversity and inclusion.

Summary

At Leader Bank, we recognize that data is an opportunity to create better experiences, smarter decisions, and value for our clients. As a BI Analyst, you enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions and turn insights into action through automation.

The BI Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the Bank's enterprise reporting and analytics platform. This role bridges business reporting and data engineering by creating trusted data models, semantic layers, dashboards, and analytics solutions that empower data-driven decision-making across the organization.

The successful candidate will have deep experience with Snowflake, Retool/Power BI, Python, JavaScript, SQL, and modern data technologies. This individual will partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and technology teams to transform raw data into trusted, actionable insights while establishing scalable reporting and governance practices.

Responsibilities

• Data Modeling & Analytics

• Design, develop, and maintain enterprise data models, semantic layers, and analytics-ready datasets in Snowflake.

• Build and maintain data dictionaries, KPI definitions, and business metrics to ensure consistency across reporting platforms.

• Develop scalable reporting architectures that support operational, analytical, and executive reporting needs.

• Optimize data structures, queries, and warehouse performance for BI workloads.

• Reporting & Visualization

• Create and maintain dashboards, workflows and self-service reporting solutions using Retool, and other BI tools.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate business questions into actionable analytics.

• Develop executive-level dashboards and operational reporting that provide meaningful business insights.

• Ensure data visualizations are intuitive, accurate, and aligned with organizational goals.

• Data Engineering & Automation

• Develop and maintain ELT/ETL processes for structured and semi-structured data.

• Build automated data validation, quality monitoring, and reconciliation processes.

• Utilize Python, SQL, and JavaScript to automate reporting, data transformations, and analytics workflows.

• Collaborate with Data Engineers to enhance data ingestion, transformation, and governance frameworks.

• Governance & Quality

• Establish and maintain data quality standards, validation rules, and monitoring processes.

• Define and enforce data governance best practices, metadata management, and documentation standards.

• Ensure compliance with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.

• Promote adoption of trusted data sources and standardized reporting practices.

• Collaboration

• Work closely with business leaders, product managers, analysts, and engineering teams.

• Participate in Agile planning, estimation, and solution design activities.

• Provide guidance on analytics best practices, dashboard design, and data storytelling.

Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field.

• 3+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or related disciplines.

• 3+ years of hands-on experience with Snowflake or other relational databases.

• 3+ years of experience building dashboards and analytics solutions using Power BI/Tableau/Retool or similar BI platforms.

• Strong SQL expertise including performance optimization, dimensional modeling, and data warehouse design.

• Strong Python programming experience for analytics, automation, and data processing.

• Experience with JavaScript for dashboard customization, application development, and automation.

• Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.

• Knowledge of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.

• Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development practices.

• Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with dbt, Matillion or similar modern data stack technologies.

• Experience working in banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated industries.

• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS.

• Knowledge of API development and integrations.

• Experience leveraging AI and machine learning tools to improve analytics and reporting.

• Snowflake, Power BI, or cloud certifications.
